purpose: Falsifiable hypotheses linking canonical NUI decision owners to observable model behavior, matched benchmark tasks, semantic mutations, targeted ablations and bounded claim language. Registry presence is structural evidence only; efficacy requires empirical runs.

hypotheses.decision_boundary: Discover the plausible product capability envelope before compressing a broad request into screens or a familiar app archetype.
hypotheses.observable_behavior: Discovers consequential non-glamorous capability families before screen-level compression.
hypotheses.baseline_failure: Prompt-literal compression turns a broad platform request into a small dashboard-shaped feature list and silently treats first recall as complete scope.
positive_controls: Ambiguous request for a production sales-management platform
Broad creative-tool request with multiple actors and lifecycle obligations
negative_controls: Explicitly bounded one-purpose utility
Existing-screen polish task whose product scope is frozen
falsifiers: Removing product-envelope reasoning does not reduce implied-family recall on matched scope tasks
Full NUI increases irrelevant enterprise features on explicitly bounded utilities
prohibited_overclaims: NUI guarantees complete product scope
A larger capability list is automatically a better product

hypotheses.decision_boundary: Separate discovery breadth from implementation commitment by explicitly classifying material capability families.
hypotheses.observable_behavior: Explicitly resolves expected capabilities as required, expected, optional, excluded or unknown instead of silently dropping them.
hypotheses.baseline_failure: Remembered capabilities are inconsistently promoted, omitted or mixed with speculative features without rationale or authority.
positive_controls: Platform request containing plausible but not universally mandatory administration families
Product with a clear MVP boundary and several deliberately deferred capabilities
negative_controls: Single-screen calculator with no durable account or workspace model
Fixed reproduction task where feature inventory is externally authoritative
falsifiers: Ablating disposition leaves omission rate and unjustified feature inflation unchanged
Disposition protocol reduces explicit scope reasoning without improving omission accounting
prohibited_overclaims: Every expected capability must be implemented
Disposition labels prove product-market fit

hypotheses.decision_boundary: Model settings as scoped configuration architecture with taxonomy, precedence, persistence, dependency and recovery rather than a miscellaneous page.
hypotheses.observable_behavior: Builds settings around conceptual taxonomy and configuration scope semantics rather than a flat collection of unrelated toggles.
hypotheses.baseline_failure: Settings become a late miscellaneous page that mixes profile, security, billing, workspace policy and appearance without precedence or recovery.
positive_controls: Multi-workspace SaaS with user and organization policy
Professional editor with user, project and device preferences
negative_controls: Utility with three independent local preferences
Read-only public surface with no persistent configuration
falsifiers: Removing scoped settings architecture does not increase conflicting or orphan settings on matched tasks
Full NUI forces search, inheritance or enterprise policy into a tiny settings surface where they add no value
prohibited_overclaims: Every product needs a complex settings hierarchy
Settings completeness can be inferred from page count

hypotheses.decision_boundary: Connect authentication ceremony to the wider account, session, workspace, membership, recovery and exit lifecycle.
hypotheses.observable_behavior: Extends account reasoning beyond sign-in and sign-up to continuity, recovery, membership authority and terminal account states when product semantics require them.
hypotheses.baseline_failure: Authentication screens exist but session devices, invitations, workspace switching, ownership transition, revocation, recovery and deletion are absent or disconnected.
positive_controls: Team product with invitations and multiple workspaces
Security-sensitive personal service with session/device management and account recovery
negative_controls: Anonymous local-first tool without identity
Prototype explicitly excluding durable accounts
falsifiers: Account-continuity ablation does not increase lifecycle dead ends
Full NUI invents organization lifecycle in a personal anonymous tool
prohibited_overclaims: A login flow proves account completeness
All products require organizations or team workspaces

hypotheses.decision_boundary: Derive professional workspace instruments, zoning, progressive disclosure and persistent layout from capability and context rather than copying another tool's chrome.
hypotheses.observable_behavior: Maps tool-rich capabilities into context-sensitive instruments and workspace zones without either hiding critical commands or exposing every tool simultaneously.
hypotheses.baseline_failure: Complex software is reduced to a few generic panels or, conversely, all controls are placed on-screen without mode, selection, hierarchy or command reachability logic.
positive_controls: Video editor with timeline, preview, assets and inspectors
Developer desktop tool with long sessions, commands, panes and persistent workspace state
negative_controls: Simple content viewer
Single-form transactional page
falsifiers: Removing instrument architecture does not reduce command reachability or context fit
Full NUI increases simultaneous chrome without improving task coverage
prohibited_overclaims: Professional software should resemble VS Code or Canva
More visible tools imply greater professional capability

hypotheses.decision_boundary: Select among rendered aesthetic candidates through comparative, evidence-bound discrimination rather than compliance checks or scalar self-scoring.
hypotheses.observable_behavior: Makes causal pairwise visual judgments that distinguish refinement, product fit and genericness among otherwise valid rendered candidates.
hypotheses.baseline_failure: The generator calls its own first coherent design premium or beautiful, often using an opaque score and no counterfactual comparison.
positive_controls: Two polished but differently authored flagship candidates
Product-native candidate versus fashionable generic SaaS candidate
negative_controls: Pixel-faithful reproduction with no open art-direction decision
Utilitarian internal surface whose visual direction is fixed
falsifiers: Taste-court ablation does not reduce blinded preference or causal specificity
Full NUI systematically prefers decorative novelty over accessibility or product truth
prohibited_overclaims: NUI computes objective beauty
One model judge establishes universal taste

hypotheses.decision_boundary: Critique actual rendered states, diagnose visible causes, prescribe a bounded repair and verify the repair in a subsequent render.
hypotheses.observable_behavior: Finds causal visual defects in rendered evidence and closes critique with a demonstrably changed re-render rather than prose-only approval.
hypotheses.baseline_failure: The model reviews source code or a design spec, produces generic praise/criticism, and never verifies whether its suggested repair changed the artifact.
positive_controls: Rendered dashboard with competing focal points and rhythm defects
Responsive UI whose small-screen hierarchy degrades
negative_controls: Non-visual information-architecture-only artifact
Unrenderable task where visual evidence capability is explicitly unavailable
falsifiers: Spec-only critique performs equally on hidden rendered defects
Critique repairs do not improve targeted dimensions in blinded before/after judgments
prohibited_overclaims: A screenshot proves usability
A critique is successful before its repair is re-observed

hypotheses.decision_boundary: Distinguish intentional platform-native controls from accidental default/legacy residue that breaks the authored interface language or operability.
hypotheses.observable_behavior: Detects visually or behaviorally accidental platform chrome while preserving native controls that are intentional, coherent and accessible.
hypotheses.baseline_failure: A highly authored interface ships browser-default scrollbars, selects, focus cues, validation bubbles or resize affordances by accident, or hides them indiscriminately to look cleaner.
positive_controls: Custom-themed web application with mixed native/default controls
Professional workspace containing scrollbars, resize surfaces and context overlays
negative_controls: Platform-native application intentionally using standard controls
Accessibility mode that deliberately restores stronger native affordances
falsifiers: Residue audit does not improve detection of accidental defaults
Full NUI suppresses legitimate native affordances or harms keyboard/pointer operability
prohibited_overclaims: All native controls are ugly
Scrollbar hiding is always modern

hypotheses.decision_boundary: Translate domain risk, trust and density priors through the actual audience's expertise, decision posture and task context instead of applying category styling.
hypotheses.observable_behavior: Changes information density, explanation, trust cues and interaction posture when audience needs change within the same domain.
hypotheses.baseline_failure: The same visual and interaction recipe is applied to all users in a domain, such as dark dense fintech for consumers and operators alike.
positive_controls: Fintech consumer versus finance-operator variants
Creative tool for casual creator versus professional editor
negative_controls: Audience is fixed and externally specified
Pure visual reproduction task with no strategic adaptation
falsifiers: Audience ablation does not reduce cross-audience appropriateness
Full NUI stereotypes domains through fixed visual themes rather than changing task mechanics
prohibited_overclaims: Domain labels determine aesthetic style
One audience preference represents an entire industry

hypotheses.decision_boundary: Allocate motion to structural teaching, causal feedback and emotional cadence with interruption and reduced-motion equivalence, while preserving intentional stillness.
hypotheses.observable_behavior: Prioritizes task-relevant motion semantics and degrades decorative motion before feedback, progress or direct-manipulation continuity.
hypotheses.baseline_failure: Animation is added because the interface should feel modern, with equal priority for decoration and task feedback and weak reduced-motion behavior.
positive_controls: Direct-manipulation editor with stateful transforms
Long-running action with progress, cancellation and celebratory completion
negative_controls: Safety-critical confirmation where stillness improves certainty
Static reading surface with no temporal state change
falsifiers: Motion-semantics ablation does not alter task feedback quality or reduced-motion equivalence
Full NUI adds decorative motion to contexts where stillness is the safer or faster choice
prohibited_overclaims: More animation means higher quality
Reduced motion means removing all state feedback

hypotheses.decision_boundary: Verify that design intent survives tokens, component states, CSS/platform expression, responsive behavior and runtime rendering rather than stopping at a design artifact.
hypotheses.observable_behavior: Traces important design decisions through implementation and catches runtime divergence that is invisible in source design specifications.
hypotheses.baseline_failure: A polished design or component spec is treated as proof even though font fallback, line wrap, states, overlays, default chrome or responsive implementation differ at runtime.
positive_controls: Web implementation with token drift and font fallback
Responsive component system with hover, focus, loading and error states
negative_controls: Research-only design rationale with no implementation claim
Pure backend task without rendered UI
falsifiers: Design-file-only condition catches the same runtime defects as full fidelity verification
Full NUI increases false visual-regression alarms without identifying meaningful perception changes
prohibited_overclaims: Design-system compliance proves runtime fidelity
Raw pixel difference alone proves a visual regression

hypotheses.decision_boundary: Preserve capability and hierarchy across viewport/posture changes through structural recomposition rather than uniform shrink or hide-until-it-fits behavior.
hypotheses.observable_behavior: Reauthors hierarchy, zoning and interaction access for constrained viewports while preserving material capability and context.
hypotheses.baseline_failure: Desktop composition is scaled down, clipped or stripped of secondary capabilities without a semantic replacement path.
positive_controls: Dense merchant admin from desktop to phone
Professional editor moving from wide desktop to narrow split-screen
negative_controls: Fixed-size kiosk with one validated viewport
Embedded widget whose host contract fixes dimensions
falsifiers: Responsive-reauthoring ablation does not increase lost capabilities or hierarchy defects
Full NUI needlessly changes structure when a stable fixed viewport is the explicit product contract
prohibited_overclaims: Responsive means identical controls at every width
Hiding a capability is acceptable merely because mobile is smaller

hypotheses.decision_boundary: Prevent local passes in product scope, visual quality and implementation fidelity from being composed into a global pass when their cross-plane interaction remains broken.
hypotheses.observable_behavior: Detects cross-plane contradictions that survive independent local checks, such as a complete capability that becomes unreachable after responsive or visual simplification.
hypotheses.baseline_failure: Each subsystem certifies itself independently and the product ships with interaction defects that emerge only at their boundaries.
positive_controls: Full commerce admin combining roles, settings, responsive tables and rendered controls
Creative collaboration tool combining workspace instruments, permissions, motion and export states
negative_controls: Isolated visual token audit with no product-wide completion claim
Single deterministic component-state check
falsifiers: Removing compound closure does not increase interaction-boundary failures
Compound gate blocks valid isolated tasks by inventing unrelated global obligations
prohibited_overclaims: Passing every local validator proves the whole product works
One compound benchmark covers every domain interaction
